results.evidence: In _apply (cottonwood/db.py), after conn.executescript(script) the runner raises MigrationError if conn.in_transaction. It then reads user_version(conn) and raises MigrationError if the value differs from migration.number. tests/test_migrate.py has a test for each check. test_runner_refuses_a_transaction_left_open_after_a_migration uses a connection subclass that leaves a BEGIN open. test_runner_refuses_a_version_other_than_the_migration_number uses a subclass that sets user_version to 99. Both expect MigrationError. I ran .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_migrate.py and 24 passed. `uv run` panicked in this sandbox, so I used the project's .venv python instead.
